title: Custom Website Development
summary: Fast, search-friendly websites that explain what you do and turn visitors into enquiries.
description: A website designed around your business, not a template with your logo on it. Pages are written to be clear, load quickly on mobile connections, and rank for the searches your customers actually make.
problem: Your business has no website, or the one you have is slow, hard to use on a phone, or does not bring in enquiries.
deliverables: Responsive design for phone, tablet and desktop
Page structure and copy guidance focused on enquiries
On-page SEO: titles, descriptions, sitemap, structured data
Contact and quote forms that reach your inbox
Deployment, domain and HTTPS setup
A short handover so you can request edits with confidence
timeline: 2 to 5 weeks, depending on the number of pages
bestFor: Small businesses, professionals and organisations that need a credible online presence.

title: Business Web Applications
summary: Custom internal tools and customer portals that replace spreadsheets and manual follow-up.
description: When a spreadsheet, a WhatsApp group and a paper register stop scaling, a purpose-built web application keeps the work in one place, with user accounts, roles and a record of who did what.
problem: Your team tracks work across spreadsheets and chats, information goes missing, and nobody has a single reliable view.
deliverables: Requirements workshop and a written scope
User accounts with role-based access
Dashboards and reports for the numbers you track
Secure database design and backups guidance
Deployment to a server you control
Documentation for the people who will use and maintain it
bestFor: Teams, clinics, shops and service businesses with a repeatable process to digitise.

title: Python Backend & API Development
summary: Clean, documented APIs and server logic that your apps and partners can rely on.
description: The part of your product that nobody sees but everybody depends on: data models, business rules, authentication and integrations, delivered with automated tests and interactive API documentation.
problem: Your front end, mobile app or partner needs a dependable backend, or an existing backend is fragile and undocumented.
deliverables: REST API with validation and consistent error responses
Database schema and migrations
Authentication and authorisation
Automated tests and linting
Interactive API documentation
Deployment notes and environment configuration
timeline: 3 to 8 weeks, depending on the number of endpoints
bestFor: Founders and teams building a product, and businesses that need systems to talk to each other.

title: Python Automation
summary: Scripts and small tools that take repetitive manual work off your plate.
description: If someone on your team copies data between files, renames documents, builds the same report every week or sends the same messages by hand, that work can usually be automated reliably.
problem: Staff spend hours each week on copy-paste work that is slow, boring and easy to get wrong.
deliverables: A script or small tool built for your exact process
Clear instructions for running it, with logging
Handling for messy inputs and clear error messages
Scheduling on your computer or a server where appropriate
Source code you can keep
bestFor: Offices, clinics, shops and freelancers with repetitive document, spreadsheet or messaging work.

title: Data Analysis & Reporting
summary: Turn raw spreadsheets and exports into clean reports you can make decisions from.
description: Cleaning, combining and summarising your data, then presenting it in a form that answers the questions you actually have: what is selling, what is late, where is the money going.
problem: You have data in spreadsheets or exports, but no clear picture of what it says and no time to build the reports.
deliverables: Data cleaning and validation
Analysis tied to the questions you set
Tables and charts in a readable report
Reusable scripts so reports can be refreshed
A plain-language summary of findings and limits
bestFor: Managers, researchers and small businesses who need clarity from existing data.

title: Database & API Integration
summary: Connect the systems you already use so data moves without retyping.
description: Link your website, payment provider, database and internal tools so they share information automatically, with sensible error handling for the times a connection fails.
problem: Your tools do not talk to each other, so someone retypes orders, payments or contacts from one system to another.
deliverables: Integration design and a written plan
Secure handling of API keys and secrets
Retries and logging for failed calls
Webhook endpoints verified on the server
Testing against the provider's sandbox where one exists
timeline: 1 to 6 weeks, depending on the systems involved
bestFor: Businesses taking online payments or running several tools that should share data.

title: Website Maintenance
summary: Keep your site updated, secure and working after launch, without hiring a full-time developer.
description: A steady hand for the small things that pile up: content changes, dependency updates, backups, uptime checks and fixing what breaks.
problem: Your site was built and then left alone. Updates are overdue, small edits take weeks, and nobody owns problems when they appear.
deliverables: Content and small feature changes
Dependency and security updates
Backup and uptime checks
Bug fixes
A short monthly summary of what was done
bestFor: Owners of existing websites and web apps, including ones I did not build.

title: Biomedical Engineering Technical Support
summary: Software and documentation support for equipment records, maintenance schedules and technical processes in healthcare settings.
description: I combine my biomedical engineering studies with software skills to help clinics and facilities organise equipment inventories, track maintenance schedules and produce clear technical documentation and tools.
problem: Equipment records live on paper or scattered spreadsheets, maintenance dates get missed, and there is no easy way to see what needs attention.
deliverables: Equipment inventory and maintenance-tracking tools
Maintenance schedule and overdue reporting
Technical documentation and standard procedure write-ups
Data summaries for management decisions
bestFor: Small hospitals, clinics and laboratories that want better records and reporting.
note: This is technical and software support. It does not replace inspection, calibration or sign-off by licensed clinical or biomedical engineers where regulations require it.

title: Technical Documentation
summary: Clear manuals, guides and specifications that people can follow.
description: Good documentation saves support time and makes handovers safe. I write and format user guides, system documentation and procedures, and can generate them as polished PDFs.
problem: Knowledge sits in one person's head, new staff learn by asking around, and nobody can tell how a system works.
deliverables: User guides and quick-start sheets
System and API documentation
Standard operating procedures
PDF and web formats
Review rounds with your team
bestFor: Teams handing over a system, training staff or preparing for an audit.
